rows.grounds: accusative plural masculine pronoun referring to the beings just mentioned

items.question: What action does Sri Para Devi perform after seeing them?
premises: She acts from her forehead eye.
items.inference: Seeing them prompts Sri Para Devi to emit from her forehead eye.
uncertainties: The exact referent of tān is not stated in this verse.
The object of visarjayat is omitted.
items.plain_english: Seeing them, Sri Para Devi sent forth from her forehead eye.
